name: Key Internet
summary: Coffs Harbour regional ISP (key.net.au, part of the APCS family); absorbed Brown Bear Internet (2011), One.Net (2012) and smaller books incl. Argonaut/D2/Conxx/Westserv; brand folded into Jazi Group's JaziNET operation 2018-19 (business name 'Key Internet' held by JAZI GROUP PTY LTD from 18 Apr 2018).

events.details: Retail NBN/ADSL/ADSL2+ ISP running key.net.au with Brownbear/ONE/Conxx/D2/Argonaut webmail links by Dec 2014; Brown Bear Internet already 301-redirected to key.net.au by Feb 2011.

refs.label: Key Internet site (Dec 2014): webmail links for D2, Argonaut, Brownbear, ONE, Conxx

events.details: Brand folded into Jazi Group (jazi.net) — 'Key Internet' business name registered to JAZI GROUP PTY LTD from 18 Apr 2018; stablemate brand Break Free redirected to jazi.net by 27 May 2019.

refs.label: ABR: JAZI GROUP PTY LTD — business names incl. Key Internet (18 Apr 2018), JaziNET (2 Oct 2017)
